articles.title: Cosmic Crisis Averted: Dark Energy Still Drives Universe's Accelerating Expansion, New Study Confirms
articles.summary: A potential "cosmological crisis" has been resolved. New research refutes last year's claim that dark energy is weakening, confirming the universe's expansion is still accelerating. The earlier study made crucial errors in calculating supernova ages.

articles.title: Stop Fooling the Public: Expert Calls for Realistic Moon Art Ahead of Artemis Missions
articles.summary: Many artistic depictions of the lunar surface are dangerously misleading, showing a flat, dustless terrain. Scientist Daniel Britt urges artists to portray the moon's true cratered, dusty nature to better prepare engineers and the public for Artemis.

articles.title: DJI Neo Drone Drops to $169: A Pocket-Sized Powerhouse for Beginners
articles.summary: Ahead of Amazon Prime Day, the DJI Neo is $30 off. Weighing under 250g, it requires no registration and offers autonomous flight modes, 4K video, and intuitive app control—ideal for novice pilots.
